body.prompt: A Korean man in his early sixties walking out of an office building at dusk carrying a small cardboard box of his belongings and a bouquet, looking back once. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame, faces clearly lit.
